desc: Implement a sliding window median calculator using two heaps (`left` as max-heap, `right` as min-heap) to maintain the median and sums of the two halves.
Precompute an array `costs` where `costs[i]` is the minimum operations to make the subarray `nums[i-x+1...i]` have all equal elements.
Initialize a DP array `dp` of size `k+1` with infinity, setting `dp[0] = 0`.
Iterate through the array from index `x-1` to `n-1`. For each index `i`, if `i >= x-1`, calculate the cost for the window ending at `i`.

Update the DP table in reverse order (from `k` down to 1) to avoid using the same subarray multiple times for the same count: `dp[j] = min(dp[j], dp[j-1] + costs[i])` if `j-1` subarrays can be formed ending at or before `i-x`.
